incident_details.title: High Risk Alerts: NetWitness Endpoint for KELLYWANG
incident_details.description: NetWitness generated a high-risk network alert involving internal IP communication between 192.168.10.204 and 192.168.10.202, but no endpoint, process, or PowerShell evidence is available to confirm malicious execution. The parser also notes missing network context fields (destination port and protocol), reducing confidence and supporting a suspicious-but-unconfirmed assessment.
